skills.name: Luminescent Shot (流光之箭/流光の矢)
skills.line: I still remember how to wield my bow.
skills.description: SP Hotarugusa unleashes an arrow brimming with spiritual force on a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK. Then spends Dandelion Force equal to 100% of her ATK to inflict damage equal to the amount of Dandelion Force spent. ;Dandelion Force (蒲公英之力/タンポポの力) :Stores the excess healing received by non-summoned ally entities until the start of her next turn. Can store up to 1800% of SP Hotarugusa's initial ATK each time. Resets the limit at the start of her turn.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 110% and increases the amount of Dandelion Force she can use to 150%.
Damage increases to 120% and increases the amount of Dandelion Force she can use to 200%.

skills.name: Adventure On (渺渺一旅)
skills.line: Embark on a long adventure with dandelions.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. SP Hotarugusa unleashes the healing light of dandelions. When a non-summoned ally is healed, excess healing is converted into Dandelion Force. At the end of her turn, grants her 2 Seeds that are sustainable for 1 turn. When she uses a normal attack, for each portion of Dandelion Force equal to 345% of her ATK, grants her a 30% chance of launching a follow-up strike (up to 3 times), dealing Dandelion Force damage. ;Seed (種子) : :'''General, Mark''': Exclusive effect. When HP is reduced, removes 1 Seed instead. When the Seeds are used up, restores HP equal to 35% of her ATK. When receiving indirect damage, converts the indirect damage taken into Dandelion Force, doubling the restored amount. Indirect damage won't remove Seeds. Triggers up to once for a single attack. ;Dandelion Force (蒲公英之力/タンポポの力) :Stores the excess healing received by non-summoned ally entities until the start of her next turn. Can store up to 1800% of SP Hotarugusa's initial ATK each time. Resets limit at the start of her turn.

upgrades.text: Each Seed increases her own DEF by 30. Whenever a Seed is removed, increases her own SPD by 8 for 1 turn.
When a Seed is removed due to causes other than enemy attacks, increases ATK by 15%, lasts for 1 turn.
At the end of her turn, grants 2 Seeds to other allies.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically grants 2 Seed to all non-summoned allies at the start of battle.

skills.name: Luminescent Smash (萤光落世/蛍光落世)
skills.line: I wish to grant hope to the world, even if it's as tiny as me.
skills.description: SP Hotarugusa uses every bit of power to bring light to the world. She launches an attack on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 162% of her ATK, and spends Dandelion Force equal to 340% of her initial ATK to inflict damage equal to the amount of Dandelion Force spent, distributes evenly among all enemies. Also restores the HP of all allies equal to 35% of her ATK. ;Seed (種子) : :'''General, Mark''': Exclusive effect. When HP is reduced, removes 1 Seed instead. When the Seeds are used up, restores HP equal to 35% of her ATK. When receiving indirect damage, converts the indirect damage taken into Dandelion Force, doubling the restored amount. Indirect damage won't remove Seeds. Triggers up to once for a single attack. ;Dandelion Force (蒲公英之力タンポポの力) :Stores the excess healing received by non-summoned ally entities until the start of her next turn. Can store up to 1800% of SP Hotarugusa's initial ATK each time. Resets the limit at the start of her turn.

upgrades.text: Whenever she uses this skill, increases the amount of Dandelion Force she can use by 120%, up to 360%. When she receives indirect damage, decreases the amount of Dandelion Force she can use by 120%. Triggers up to once for a single attack.

bio.condition: Team SP Hotarugusa with another player's Hakurou and clear any zone 10 times.
